samples.question: The picture shows one square panel divided into a 7 by 7 lattice of equal square cells; each cell is either dark or empty, and four small brightly coloured square marks sit exactly on the four corners of the panel. Turn the whole panel about its own centre by a quarter turn, by a half turn and by three quarters of a turn, so that you have the panel as printed plus those three turned copies of it, all four laid on top of one another in the same square outline. Keep a cell only where the panel is dark in the printed copy and in all three turned copies as well; discard every other cell. The kept cells form exactly one of these five symbols: plus (one full centre row and one full centre column crossing), ex (both full corner-to-corner diagonals crossing), ring (a hollow square outline one cell thick, standing clear of the panel edge), diamond (a hollow diamond outline one cell thick, with a single cell at the middle of each panel edge), corners (four separate two-by-two blocks, one in each corner of the panel, and nothing else). Which symbol do the kept cells form? Answer with one word.
